thesis: Millstone gave control decks a repeatable win condition that ignored life totals and eventually lent its name to the entire strategy of milling libraries.

competitiveTimeline.significance: From early control to dedicated prison and casual decks, Millstone transformed an obscure loss condition into one of Magic’s permanent strategic vocabularies.

playbook.role: Stabilize the battlefield before investing mana in activations, and count the opponent’s remaining draw steps rather than treating every mill as immediate progress.
